column1: # How a POM names a licence, and the SPDX id it stands for in licences.tsv
# (LICENSE-001); tool/check_maven_licences.js reads the artifacts the Android
# build links (android/app/maven_licences.gradle) through it. Columns: a
# case-insensitive pattern over the licence's name and URL, the SPDX id; the
# first pattern that matches wins, so a narrower one comes first. A row whose
# pattern is `gradle:<group>:<artifact>` is that artifact's licence read by
# hand, for a POM that names none, with why. A licence no row matches fails.
general public license, version 2, with the classpath exception
